name: 獎金 (bonus)
description: The entry quantity is the bonus paid. Whether it is work remuneration or a nonregular award stays with the payroll source and the income-tax and health-insurance schemes; the payment itself is a gross earning.

references.title: 健保法 §31(1): a bonus from the employer counts toward the supplementary premium above four times the insured amount; 所得稅法 §14: taxable salary income, so it is withheld (INCOME_TAX_BONUS / INCOME_TAX_NON_RESIDENT) and enters the unit’s §34 salary total (全民健康保險法 §34: 每月支付之薪資所得總額, 所得稅格式代號 50 — bonuses included).

eligibility: return ctx.entry.unit === 'MONEY' && ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

name: 資遣費 (severance pay)
description: The entry quantity is the average monthly wage under LSA §2(4). Old-system service before 1 July 2005 pays one month per year and the remainder under the new system half a month per year, capped at six months; a recorded old-system service figure in the employment's extension data replaces the pre-Act default.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §17(1)(2) with §2: one month's average wage for each year of the old-system service, half a month for the new system, capped at six months.

name: 預告期間工資 (notice pay)
description: The entry quantity is the average daily wage under LSA §2(4). The statutory notice period steps with completed service; the employment model holds no served-notice evidence, so the catalogue pays the statutory period in full and the payroll source records any notice actually given.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §16(1): ten days of notice after three months, twenty after one year, thirty after three years, paid as wages in lieu.

name: 舊制退休金 (old-system retirement pay)
description: The entry quantity is the average monthly wage. Old-system service pays two months per year for the first fifteen years and one thereafter, capped at forty-five months; the statutory age and service bands select the entitlement and a duty-caused disability carries the statutory uplift.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §55(1)(1)–(2): two months' average wages for each of the first fifteen years of old-system service, one for each year after, capped at forty-five months.

name: 職業災害補償抵充 (§59 insurance offset)
description: The entry quantity is the insurer benefit the employer elects to offset against its §59 compensation for the same accident. A net-pay deduction that leaves every wage and insured base untouched.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §59 proviso: compensation already paid by labour or occupational-accident insurance from the employer's premiums, or under another law, is deducted.

eligibility: return ctx.entry.unit === 'MONEY' && ctx.entry.quantity > 0;

name: 法院扣押薪資 (court wage garnishment)
description: The entry quantity is the amount the served attachment order fixes for the period. A net-pay deduction; the order's one-third ceiling and the debtor's reserved living costs bind the court, not this catalogue.

references.title: 強制執行法 §115-1: 對於薪資或其他繼續性給付之債權所為強制執行…其效力及於扣押後應受及增加之給付; the attachment order on 自然人因提供勞務而獲得之繼續性報酬債權 不得逾各期給付數額三分之一, unless the execution court, weighing both sides' circumstances, departs from that ratio while reserving the debtor's 生活費用; under a 移轉命令 the employer (third-party garnishee) pays the attached portion to the creditor, otherwise as the order directs. §115-1 predates every version. The one-third ceiling binds the court's order, not the employer: the employer deducts exactly the amount the served order fixes for the period, entered by HR with the order as evidence. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on how the garnishee books the deduction; default a net-pay deduction after every statutory line, touching no wage, insured, pension or tax base — lawful because the attached claim is the worker's wage itself, so tax and insurance stay on the whole wage (所得稅法 §14, 勞保條例 §14). Remittance to the creditor or court is an external payment.

description: The entry quantity is the monthly food-and-lodging charge. The agreed monthly cap recorded in the employment's extension data limits it.

name: 離職後競業禁止補償 (non-compete compensation, monthly after exit)

references.title: 勞動基準法 §9-1(1)(4), (2): a post-employment non-compete needs reasonable compensation and lasts at most two years.
